lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:
The Formless Lord created the universe of form.
By the Hukam of His Command, He created attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape khel kare sabh karataa sun saachaa ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True Lord, enshrine Him in your mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa maaee trai gun parasoot jamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Maya, the mother, gave birth to the three gunas, the three qualities,
and proclaimed the four Vedas to Brahma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਥਿਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: varhe maah vaar thitee kar is jag mahi sojhee paaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: Creating the years, months, days and dates, He infused intelligence into the world. ||2||
Service to the Guru is the most excellent action.
Enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gurabaanee varatee jag a(n)tar is baanee te har naam paaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani prevails throughout the world; through this Bani, the Lord's Name is obtained. ||3||
He reads the Vedas, but he starts arguments night and day.
He does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai sadaa dukh paae trai gun bharam bhulaaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, he suffers in pain forever; he is deluded by doubt, and confused by the three gunas. ||4||
The Gurmukh is in love with the One Lord alone;
he submerges in his mind the three-phased desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad sadaa hai mukataa maaiaa mohu chukaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he is liberated forever; he renounces emotional attachment to Maya. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur raate se hun raate ||
lines.translation: Those who are so pre-ordained to be imbued, are imbued with love for the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively intoxicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa prabh paaiaa aapai aap milaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru forever, they find God; He Himself unites them with Himself. ||6||
In attachment to Maya and doubt, the Lord is not found.
Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: soohaa ra(n)g din thoRe hovai is jaade bilam na laaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: The crimson color lasts for only a few days; all too soon, it fades away. ||7||
So color this mind in the Fear and the Love of God.
Dyed in this color, one merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag ko ihu ra(n)g paae guramatee ra(n)g chaRaaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: By perfect destiny, some may obtain this color. Through the Guru's Teachings, this color is applied. ||8||
The self-willed manmukhs take great pride in themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragah kab hee na paavai maan ||
lines.translation: In the Court of the Lord, they are never honored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: doojai laage janam gavaaiaa bin boojhe dukh paaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: Attached to duality, they waste their lives; without understanding, they suffer in pain. ||9||
My God has hidden Himself deep within the self.
By Guru's Grace, one is united in the Lord's Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa prabh sachaa vaapaaraa naam amolak paaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: God is True, and True is His trade, through which the priceless Naam is obtained. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is kaaiaa kee keemat kinai na paaee ||
lines.translation: No one has found this body's value.
My Lord and Master has worked His handiwork.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s kaaiaa sodhai aapahi aap milaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh purifies his body, and then the Lord unites him with Himself. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa vich totaa kaaiaa vich laahaa ||
lines.translation: Within the body, one loses, and within the body, one wins.
The Gurmukh seeks the self-sustaining Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh vanaj sadaa sukh paae sahaje sahaj milaaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh trades, and finds peace forever; he intuitively merges in the Celestial Lord. ||12||
True is the Lord's Mansion, and True is His treasure.
The Great Giver Himself gives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saalaahe sukhadaate man mele keemat paaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Giver of peace; his mind is united with the Lord, and he comes to know His worth. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa vich vasat keemat nahee paaee ||
lines.translation: Within the body is the object; its value cannot be estimated.
He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis daa hat soee vath jaanai guramukh dei na pachhotaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: He alone knows this object, to whom this store belongs; the Gurmukh is blessed with it, and does not come to regret. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu sabh mahi rahiaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is pervading and permeating all.
By Guru's Grace, He is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel milaae aape sabade sahaj samaaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: He Himself unites in His Union; through the Word of the Shabad, one intuitively merges with Him. ||15||
